channel.description: Latest articles from Solomon Times Online(Honiara) (solomontimes.com)

item.title: Pacific Ministers Push to Lock in Clean Energy Transition - Solomon Times Online
item.description: Driven by Pacific leadership, the International Maritime Organisation is on the brink of making history with binding regulations to phase out fossil fuel use in global shipping.

item.title: Kilu'ufi Hospital Receives New Vehicle - Solomon Times Online
item.description: To improve healthcare service delivery in rural areas, the Ministry of Health and Medical Services has handed over a new Toyota Land Cruiser Double Cabin to Kiluúfi Hospital in Malaita Province.

item.title: Solomon Islands Workers Shine at Agri Labour Australia Awards in Victoria - Solomon Times Online
item.description: Solomon Islands workers were honoured for their outstanding performance at the Agri Labour Australia Awards Night, held at Moe in Victoria over the weekend.

item.title: Solomon Airlines Launches Exclusive 7-Day Sale - Solomon Times Online
item.description: Solomon Airlines is excited to announce a limited-time 7-day sale offering 25% off return Economy Class fares on all international routes.

item.title: Guadalcanal Schools Supported with Menstrual Hygiene Kits - Solomon Times Online
item.description: World Vision Solomon Islands (WVSI) officially handed over much-needed menstrual hygiene kits to St. Francis Community High School and Selwyn College, marking a significant step towards ensuring girls can consistently attend their classes.

item.title: CBSI Grants Money Transfer Service License to IumiCash - Solomon Times Online
item.description: The Central Bank of Solomon Islands (CBSI) has officially granted IumiCash ltd with a Money Transfer Service (MTS) license.

item.title: Driving Standards to Improve as Honiara Traffic Increases - Solomon Times Online
item.description: The Ministry of Infrastructure Development is enhancing driving standards to ensure a safer future for all road users.

item.title: Solomon Islands and Saudi Fund Enters into Landmark Agreement - Solomon Times Online
item.description: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) has signed its first-ever development cooperation agreement in the Pacific region with the Government of Solomon Islands (SIG), marking a historic milestone in bilateral relations between the two nations.

item.title: Infrastructure Ministry Urges Public to Protect Road Reserves - Solomon Times Online
item.description: The Ministry of Infrastructure Development’s (MID) is urging property owners and communities in Honiara and the provinces to stop building on designated road reserves.

item.title: Solomon Islands and San Marino Establish Diplomatic Relations - Solomon Times Online
item.description: The Agreement to establish diplomatic relations was signed by Her Excellency Mrs. Jane Waetara, Permanent Representative of Solomon Islands to the United Nations, and His Excellency Damiano Beleffi, Permanent Representative of San Marino to the United Nations.
